dct_description_sm:
Mapping depicts Brampton Plan Schedule 6c Highly Vulnerable Aquifers which are underground water sources that are particularly susceptible to contamination due to geological and hydrological characteristics.

Highly Vulnerable Aquifers are groundwater resources that are particularly susceptible to contamination from activities occurring at or near the ground surface. These areas require careful management and protection to safeguard drinking water quality and maintain the long-term viability of groundwater resources.

This data is intended to be used in conjuction with other related mapping layers for this schedule, and may be impacted by other schedules, with consideration to the text of Brampton Plan.
